payload.entry: PLANNING EVIDENCE: No earlier phase notes or landed repair found; bob-plugins e8a776ee909e38aaeb2031e26197b6dc0522189e retains the f0c1c97 ranker/test and original index decoration. Unmodified focused test on athena Node v20.19.2: 3/5 pass, snapshot/order 74.4 ms > 50 and rank 13.9 ms > 12. Identical source bytes evaluated through SSH stdin on apollo Node v18.19.1: 3/5 pass, 95.2 ms and 16.8 ms respectively; no remote repo reads or writes. Both use process.cpuUsage fallback, not thread CPU. In-memory ablations implicate spread-plus-appended snapshot row properties and cached search-field order: fresh Object.assign copy plus search-text-first fields yielded snapshot/order 18.56–30.76 ms and rank 1.32–11.22 ms over seven sequential samples. A fresh athena process using only that decorateRow substitution passed the original 5/5 performance tests. Source/test files remain unchanged. A medium tale is validated for the local production repair, real cached-versus-uncached parity tests, profiling, repeated cross-host controls, full gates and sync; implementation is deferred only to the explicitly requested plan approval, not an oversized unfinished coding attempt. No epic-symbol entries currently exist. Preliminary measurements are not final acceptance evidence.

HomesEngine::finish collects global-inspect homes and extra areas, then remember() after the resolver borrow drops so ensure_root never re-borrows. Regression native::stats::homes::tests::single_metric_worked_today_resolves_unseen_inspect_roots panicked at homes.rs:412 "RefCell already borrowed" before the fix and passed after on Explicit(["worked"]) range 2026-10-18..2026-10-18 (today). bob-cli-hp close evidence: cargo test -p bob-obsidian --lib --exact native::completion::kinds::tests::every_table_entry_matches_the_tree and native::catalog::tests::public_leaves_are_entries_or_excluded both passed.
